scope: Real Linux source Electron conversation with saved synthetic rich history, actual core/bridge and disabled agent discovery/update polling. Pre-collection observations precede a separately labelled diagnostic renderer GC at each boundary; earlier phases have already requested GC, so this does not measure uninterrupted natural-GC behavior. No production forced GC. Cold-ready observation includes polling and IO, not paint completion or general throughput. PSS excludes Xvfb, detached helpers and driver allocations outside app descendants. No model/provider, installer, native Windows/macOS or leak-free claim.
